credentials.description: API key sent as a bearer token. Required unless passed in settings.
Optional base URL override. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1.

notes: OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions language models with hosted tools, plus embeddings, images, speech, transcription, Decisions, extraction, files, skills, batch and Live realtime sessions. languageModel uses the Responses API; use chatModel for Chat Completions.
